8496|944c29ff.name: Liv Rizzlefix
8496|944c29ff.text:
Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.

You've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...

Tanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?

<Liv shakes her head.>

No, that's not it...

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

451-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-complete.text:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, $N.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
451-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

496-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-complete.text: These specimens are perfect.  Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day.  Your efforts are appreciated.
496-complete.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

499-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
499-accept.text:
It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

There we go!  Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
499-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

527-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-complete.text: At ease, $c.  I see you have returned from battle.  My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
527-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-accept.text:
Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked.  Most excellent.

Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad.  The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.

Prove them wrong, $N.  Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants.  Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

Dismissed!
528-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-progress.text: You have your orders, $c.  Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.
528-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-accept.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-accept.text:
I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad.  So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself?  You see I am collecting human skulls.  And you will be fighting humans for quite some time.  Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
546-accept.title: Souvenirs of Death

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

98299-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-complete.text:
It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.

Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?
98299-complete.title: Stop the Spread
